visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women dressed in white tank tops, caps, and wide denim-tracksuit hybrid pants stand side-by-side on a wide urban rooftop. They begin a synchronized dance routine characterized by sharp, controlled arm movements and rhythmic stepping as they face the camera. The background features a city skyline under a clear, bright blue sky with natural daylight illuminating the scene evenly. (2) As the dance progresses, the duo incorporates more dynamic leg movements and synchronized kicks. They maintain cheerful facial expressions, smiling directly at the lens. The camera captures them in a full-body shot, highlighting their coordination and the urban environment. The lighting remains bright and consistent, emphasizing the textures of their clothing and the concrete rooftop. (3) The sequence transitions to medium shots that focus more on their upper bodies and expressive hand gestures. Their movements remain perfectly in sync as they perform rhythmic bounces and arm rotations. The background buildings provide a sense of depth and urban context. The editing introduces straight cuts that emphasize the rhythmic nature of the dance performance. (4) In the final moments, the dancers perform a series of pointing gestures toward the camera while maintaining their energetic poses. They finish with a confident stance, looking directly at the viewer. The sunlight casts soft shadows on the ground, indicating a high sun position. No text overlays or graphics appear throughout this concluding visual phase.
